title: COTA Karting
specs: 15-turn karting track with wide turns, S-turns, and hairpin
Separate kiddie karting track next to adult track
Mini golf courses themed on COTA and champions
Single and double kart drivers must be at least 16 years old and 58 inches tall with a valid driver's license
Double kart passengers must be at least 48 inches tall
Maximum weight limit for single karts is 275 lbs
Drivers must be able to sit safely with restraints, grab steering wheel with both hands, and press pedals with both legs
Hair below shoulders must be pulled back or tucked in for safety
Zipline requires minimum height 48 inches (42 if accompanied by adult), max weight 300 lbs per passenger, 450 lbs gross
Karting parties available with private reserved space, photo ops, private races, food and beverage

services.name: By Bike
services.desc: Cruise COTA’s famed stars and stripes in an stress-free environment without the worry of city traffic while enjoying music at Turn 9! After the evening ride concludes, cyclists can replenish and recharge with an ice-cold drink, mouth-watering food and great conversations and camaraderie with fellow riders. Cross the finish line like so many World Champions before you. Our 20 turns are calling your name. Join beginning and experienced cyclers alike on an exciting bike ride on the only permanent purpose-built Formula 1 track in the United States. Food trucks will be offering a delicious selection of meals that riders can purchase before or after their trip around the track! We hit the track

services.name: COTA Karting
services.desc: Come and race it! COTA Karting is a purpose-built outdoor karting track designed to thrill and challenge drivers of all ages and skill levels. Our fastest class of karts can reach speeds of up to 35mph on the fifteen turn raceway, and there are many more classes to choose based on your own personal need for speed.
